三颗星，能跳出这么多完美的舞吗？: Can three stars dance in so many perfect patterns?
为什么三颗星会失控，又能共舞？: Why do three stars run wild, and still dance?
两个天体的轨迹是圆锥曲线。再加一颗星，微分方程仍然简洁，却没有同样能直接代入的通: Two bodies follow conic sections. Add a third and the differential equations stay simple, but there is no equally usable general formula. In 1890 Poincaré showed the general three-body problem has no closed-form solution: unsolvable means no general formula, not that no solutions exist.

模型：三个点质量、牛顿引力、三维自适应 RK4。一个周期结束后回到发表的初值，轨: Model: three point masses, Newtonian gravity, 3D adaptive RK4. After one period it reseeds the published initial conditions and breaks the trail, so it does not draw a straight line through empty space. Nudge mode turns that reset off. Real stars also feel tides, mass loss, and relativistic corrections.
平面解和空间解不是一回事: Planar and spatial solutions are not the same thing
三体问题本身在三维空间里。如果三颗星的起点和速度都贴在同一个平面，它们会一直走在: The three-body problem lives in three-dimensional space. If the starting points and velocities all lie in one plane, the stars stay on that sheet: a planar periodic orbit. An out-of-plane height or velocity usually leaves the plane. Named dances, equal-mass 695, and unequal-mass 1,349 are planar families. Open Spatial 3D for the 2025 spatial orbits of Li and Liao.
每一格都在积分，不是贴图: Every cell is integrating, not a pasted picture
本页没有复制论文的图、动画或程序。每一格都用牛顿引力和三维自适应 RK4，对发表: This page does not copy figures, movies, or programs from the papers. Each cell integrates published initial conditions under Newtonian gravity with adaptive 3D RK4. The stars are moving; the trails are the paths they take. The spatial tab holds 2,416 orbits from the 10,059 found in 2025: every linearly stable orbit, every piano-trio orbit, and the shortest orbit of each mass.
底栏四族对应哪组文献: Which papers the four atlas families come from
「名解」主要来自 Šuvakov 2013 的平面命名轨道，加上欧拉直线、拉格朗: Named dances follow Šuvakov 2013 planar orbits, plus Euler’s collinear solution, Lagrange’s triangle, and Moore’s figure-eight. Equal mass · 695 is Li and Liao 2017; Unequal mass · 1,349 is Li, Jing and Liao 2018 — both planar tables. Spatial 3D is the 2025 spatial catalog: the third mass starts at z₀, and the first two have opposite out-of-plane speeds.
